entries.name: embedStream

entries.jsdocSummary: Embeds a source of any length as a `ReadableStream` of `{ item, result }` in source order. Pull based: the source is read only while the reader is reading and fewer than `maxPending` items are in flight, so memory stays flat over a corpus. A failed request does not end the stream: each of its items gets the failure as its `result`. The first item of a request carries that request's `usage`; the others carry zero, so summing every item's usage gives the total. Cancelling the stream (or aborting `signal`) aborts the requests in flight and reads no more from the source. A throw from the source, `text` or a custom `embed` is a bug and errors the stream.

entries.jsdocSummary: `embedStream` options: the per-call options, the text of each item, and how far ahead it may run.

entries.name: withCache
entries.signature: export declare function withCache(embedder: Embedder, store?: CacheStore, options?: CacheOptions): Embedder;
entries.jsdocSummary: The same embedder with a vector cache in front. Cached inputs are filled from `store`; the rest go to the provider as one call, in order. A key covers the space, the purpose, the truncation choice, the namespace and the exact text, so a model, size or prompt change misses instead of answering a wrong vector in the right shape. Image inputs always go to the provider. `usage.cacheHits` counts the inputs the store answered.

entries.name: withMiddleware
entries.signature: export declare function withMiddleware(embedder: Embedder, ...middleware: readonly EmbedMiddleware[]): Embedder;
entries.jsdocSummary: The same embedder with its `embed` wrapped by each middleware, the first one outermost: it sees the call first and the result last. `model` and `space` stay the wrapped embedder's own.

entries.name: withResilience
entries.signature: export declare function withResilience(embedder: Embedder, policy?: Policy<never, ResilienceFailure>): Embedder;
entries.jsdocSummary: The same embedder with each `embed` call run through a resilience policy. It retries only `RateLimited` and `ModelUnavailable { reason: 'unreachable' }`; every other failure comes back after one attempt. `usage.requests` counts every attempt. A timeout, an open circuit or a full bulkhead is `ModelUnavailable { reason: 'unreachable' }`, a cancel is `Cancelled`: nothing is thrown for them.

entries.name: withTelemetry
entries.signature: export declare function withTelemetry(embedder: Embedder, options?: TelemetryOptions): Embedder;
entries.jsdocSummary: The same embedder with one `arki.embed` event per `embed` call, at `info`. `@arki/log` has no span type, so the event is the span: it carries the duration and, through `@arki/log/otel`, the active trace. Fields: `provider`, `model`, `dimensions`, `inputs` (the count), `tokenBasis`, `tokens`, `requests`, `cacheHits`, `durationMs` and `outcome` (`'ok'` or the failure's code). Input texts are left out unless `recordInputs: true`.

entries.jsdocSummary: Loads a model in process and embeds one probe text, so `dimensions` is what the weights produce. Concurrent calls with the same id, revision, dtype, device and cache dir share one load; the session is freed when every record from it has called `dispose()`. `countTokens` is exact (the loaded tokenizer). Each call loads its own session; `dispose()` frees it. Qwen3-Reranker scores one document per model run: its output holds a logit per vocabulary entry (151k) at every position.
